name: Path Dimension / Radon Number (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the full cube $2^{[n]}$, $\mathrm P(2^{[n]})=n$ while its Radon number is $\lfloor\log_2(2n+2)\rfloor$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, the Radon number is $n$ while $\mathrm P(\mathcal S_n)=2\ (n\ge3)$.
proof: In the first listed family the ratio of path dimension to the other parameter tends to infinity. In the singleton family, for n>=3 the other parameter grows linearly in n while path dimension is two. Thus neither universal affine upper bound holds. This does not assert functional incomparability.
proof_source: Database-owned value records 144,149,628,627. Endpoint-complete path convention; the singleton path value is min{n-1,2}, not one. T2 reviewed these witness contracts; imported cube Radon input remains attributed.
